$comment: AUTHORED. Token export policy v0.3 for snapshot → DTCG (architecture: chavosh-token-export-architecture.md, frozen; evolved from the proof archive, tags proof-1-closed / proof-2-closed; see docs/decisions). Contains no token values: all values come from the public Figma snapshot (derived from the private raw capture; ADR 0011).

publicSnapshots.$comment: Frozen canonical Button capture (29 Sep 2026). Never re-captured (ADR 0012).
Canonical Link capture (30 Sep 2026, exporter plugin v0.4.0). Released in M1 (ADR 0012).
Canonical Checkbox capture (30 Sep 2026, exporter plugin v0.4.0). Released in M2 (ADR 0014).
Canonical Radio capture (30 Sep 2026, exporter plugin v0.4.0). Released in M3 (ADR 0015).
Canonical Switch capture (30 Sep 2026, exporter plugin v0.4.0). Released in M4 (ADR 0016).

$stagedSnapshotsComment: Recorded canonical captures (30 Sep 2026) whose components are not released yet. They pass the same provenance gate and cross-capture consistency check as publicSnapshots but do not enter the build or the public CSS surface. Each moves to publicSnapshots (with a components entry and contract) in its own milestone.

variableTypes.$comment: Figma resolvedType → DTCG $type. FLOAT and STRING carry no DTCG type in Figma: every FLOAT/STRING path must match exactly one rule, otherwise conversion fails. Dimensions are Figma px, recorded as DTCG dimension objects {value, unit: "px"}. font/weight/* → DTCG fontWeight (number 1–1000). font/family/* → DTCG fontFamily (string exactly as Figma stores it; web fallbacks live in web-policy.json, not in DTCG). layout/columns stays unclassified (deferred).

textStyles.$comment: G3: no typography composites in v1. Text styles are validated and recorded in the manifest for traceability (style → per-property tokens); nothing is emitted for them.

Button.$comment: G4: export = dependency closure of Button's bindings. G6: Button v1 is labels only, so bindings on (or inside) the icon and spinner layers are recorded in the snapshot but do not enter the export closure. Layer names as they exist in Figma (read-only inspection, 29 Sep 2026).

Link.$comment: G4: export = dependency closure of Link's bindings. Link v1 is labels only (approved), so bindings on (or inside) the leading/trailing icon layers are recorded in the snapshot but do not enter the export closure. The Figma-only underline layer stays in scope: it binds the same link colours the production text-decoration uses. Layer names from the 30 Sep 2026 capture.

Checkbox.$comment: G4: export = dependency closure of Checkbox's bindings. Every layer is in scope: the check/dash glyph is internal vector geometry (not an icon instance) and the supporting text is part of the v1 API. Layer names from the 30 Sep 2026 capture.

Radio.$comment: G4: export = dependency closure of Radio's bindings. Every layer is in scope: the dot is intrinsic Radio geometry (not an icon) and the supporting text is part of the v1 API. Layer names from the 30 Sep 2026 capture.

Switch.$comment: G4: export = dependency closure of Switch's bindings. Every layer is in scope: the track and thumb are intrinsic Switch geometry (not icons) and the supporting text is part of the v1 API. Layer names from the 30 Sep 2026 capture.
